venue.note: Deliberations happen off-site. The record below is curated from the Rising Compass Discord (or anywhere the discourse occurs). Rising Compass holds the public record; the venue is transparent.

statuses.label: Proposed
statuses.description: Open for co-sponsorship. Awaiting the threshold to open the deliberation window.

statuses.label: Deliberating
statuses.description: Co-sponsor bar cleared. The floor is open for the deliberation window.

statuses.label: Ratified
statuses.description: Accepted by supermajority. Applied to the tenets.

statuses.label: Already Covered
statuses.description: Raised in good faith, but the substance is already held by an existing tenet. Logged publicly so the coverage of the constitution is made explicit over time.

statuses.label: Rejected
statuses.description: Went through deliberation and did not clear the ratification bar.

amendments.title: Refine violet-03 to clarify the scope of 'sacred'
amendments.proposed_change: Narrow the scope of 'sacred' in violet-03 to content invoking the divine or the numinous directly, to avoid false positives on songs that merely use reverent tone without substantive sacred content.
amendments.novelty_argument: Not covered by any existing tenet; current wording conflates tone with substance.
amendments.soundness_argument: Tightens calibration without lowering the ceiling. A song can still reach Ascended via other tenets even if it does not invoke the sacred.

amendments.title: Add a tenet addressing algorithmically optimized lyrics
amendments.proposed_change: Introduce a new tenet (or modifier) for lyrics structured primarily for short-form retention loops — hooks written for the algorithm, not for the listener's inner life.
amendments.novelty_argument: This pattern did not meaningfully exist when the original tenets were drafted. It is a distinct failure mode, not a subset of any current tier.
amendments.soundness_argument: Measurable via lyrical structure (repeat count, hook length, payload-to-hook ratio). Keeps the instrument current without redefining existing tenets.

amendments.title: Distinguish decorative pain from exploited pain in orange-05
amendments.proposed_change: Split orange-05 into two readings: (a) pain as aesthetic texture inside an honest song, and (b) pain performed for engagement value. Only (b) counts toward Degraded.
amendments.novelty_argument: Current wording flattens two very different artistic moves into one verdict.
amendments.soundness_argument: Honors the difference between a song that wears pain and a song that sells it.

amendments.title: Narrow red-07 so artistic protest is not read as incitement
amendments.proposed_change: Amend red-07 to explicitly exempt protest-as-art: confrontational content aimed at a named structural ill, not at a people or a person, does not qualify as Corrupted on this tenet alone.
amendments.novelty_argument: Protest art has been scored under red-07 in ways that would retroactively implicate canonical protest songs. That is a failure mode, not calibration.
amendments.soundness_argument: Preserves red-07's teeth against actual incitement while cutting out a class of false positives.

amendments.title: Promote blue-02 gratitude from optional to required Elevated marker
amendments.proposed_change: Currently blue-02 is one of several paths to Elevated. This amendment would require some form of gratitude, humility, or acknowledgement of received grace as a floor for Elevated.
amendments.novelty_argument: Not covered; this is a structural change to how Elevated is reached, not a rewording.
amendments.soundness_argument: Elevated tier has drifted upward. Pinning a required marker keeps the tier meaningful without raising the ceiling.

amendments.title: Add 'cultural masquerade' to the contamination modifier
amendments.proposed_change: Include cultural masquerade — affecting a cultural identity that is not one's own for aesthetic leverage — as a contamination trigger that can drag an otherwise Elevated reading downward.
amendments.novelty_argument: Distinct from existing contamination triggers; the pattern had grown common enough to warrant explicit coverage.
amendments.soundness_argument: Measurable; fits the shape of the existing contamination mechanism.

amendments.title: Reword green-04 'ordinary' → 'plainly human'
amendments.proposed_change: The word 'ordinary' in green-04 was reading as pejorative in practice, flattening songs that belonged in Decent toward Degraded. Replace with 'plainly human'.
amendments.novelty_argument: Semantic precision, not a new concept.
amendments.soundness_argument: Removes an observed calibration drift without changing what the tenet measures.

amendments.title: Add a tenet on ghostwriting and authorship
amendments.proposed_change: A new tenet distinguishing songs written by the performer from songs written for the performer, treating ghostwritten material as lower-frequency.
amendments.rejection_reason: Authorship and intention are already held under green-07. The proposed change would duplicate existing coverage rather than extend it. If the concern is that credits are opaque, that is a data problem, not a tenet gap.

amendments.title: Make explicit language automatic Corruption
amendments.proposed_change: Any use of profanity should classify the song as Corrupted.
amendments.rejection_reason: red-03 already distinguishes profanity-as-shock from profanity-as-authentic-expression. A categorical rule would collapse that distinction and misclassify canonical works. The constitution measures the message, not the vocabulary.

amendments.title: Add a sixth tier above Ascended ('Transcendent')
amendments.proposed_change: Introduce a Transcendent tier above Ascended for works that go beyond the current ceiling of the instrument.
amendments.novelty_argument: Not covered; no tier above Ascended currently exists.
amendments.soundness_argument: Would let the instrument register rare outliers at the top.
amendments.rejection_reason: Deliberation concluded that adding a tier would require restructuring the entire instrument — the Compass, the chart, the rubric, and years of back-calibration. Ascended is the top of the instrument by design. The rarity the proposer wanted to capture is better read from how often Ascended is reached, not by adding a ceiling above it. Did not clear the 66% supermajority (57%).
